comparison.objective: Mount a filled malt cup on a spindle mixer so its rim actuates the motor switch.
comparison.physical_skill: Tip and lift a heavy open cup around an obstructing spindle, thread its rim behind a guide, and seat it without spilling.
comparison.success_condition: Cup released and still on the run step, spindle inside, switch pin lifted, with tilt never exceeding 65 degrees.
comparison.reason: Tests constrained cup mounting and spill avoidance, not impact fracture or loose metallic-fragment containment.
